summary: Users reported receiving physical letters impersonating Trezor that instructed recipients to scan a QR code to activate an authentication feature. The QR code directed to a fraudulent domain designed to capture sensitive wallet information.
user_mistake: scanning a QR code from an unsolicited letter and accessing a look alike domain
prevention: Access Trezor services only through the official trezor.io domain entered manually and ignore unsolicited QR codes requesting wallet actions
